wholePhysicalScope: Named four-corner historic church footprint, OpenStreetMap way 515100191. The outline controls 41 by 22 m limits and the eastern sanctuary orientation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the battered enclosure, roofless nave, eastern dome and keep. Near levels show the stone cornice, recessed arch reveals, portals and granite columns.
limitations: The model depicts the May 2024 exterior of the historic church and southern keep. The protected wall paintings and the modern buildings surrounding the courtyard are outside this exterior model’s scope.

The Qualla photo gives the batter, cornice and two rows of niches. The photographed dominant wall is interpreted as the western end. Exact rear opening counts, the heights of the top surfaces and the keep’s geometry are estimated.

The open nave, east sanctuary, dome and southern keep follow published architectural records. The mapped outline controls the main church; the keep and roof subdivision are approximate. The original elevation samples remain unchanged.
